title: Certified Pre-Owned Devices
heroDescription: Evergreen Wireless redefines value in the Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) industry—delivering top-tier devices at competitive prices, all backed by a standard two-year warranty for peace of mind.
valueLead: Every Evergreen Wireless CPO device comes bundled with premium accessories at no extra cost, making it a complete out-of-the-box solution.
valueFooter: Top-tier devices at competitive prices with a standard two-year warranty.
warrantyDescription: In the unlikely event that your CPO device requires repair during the warranty period, we will send you a replacement device of the same or better model. You have 30 days to transfer your data before returning the defective device.
gradingDescription: Evergreen Wireless uses industry standard grading for all CPO Devices, ensuring compliance and transparency. Our functional condition grading is guaranteed!
refurbDescription: Evergreen Wireless utilizes certified Device Repair Technicians to restore devices back to like-new condition through our comprehensive refurbishment process:
